description: Realignment of Mitchell Highway at Copper Hill, 4 to 6km north of Molong stage one is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. The proposed realignment of the Mitchell Highway, between 4 and 6km north of Molong, involves the construction of a new bridge over Molong Creek and the construction of a railway crossing. It is proposed that construction of the Proposal proceed in two discreet stages to minimise disruption to traffic. Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing).
